module: Node "Keep Vehicle" (category `once_instant`). Marks a vehicle to keep when the flowgraph stops (by default the vehicles created during execution are deleted) via `mgr.modules.vehicle:setKeepVehicle(vehId, keep)`. Input pins: `vehId`, `keep` (bool).

C.desc: Flowgraph node class (returned by `_flowgraph_createNode(C)`). Definition fields: name, description, category, pinSchema, tags.

workOnce.desc: Calls `setKeepVehicle` if `vehId` is defined and copies the input flow to the output.
